label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.problem: Between the colour filters and the size and Add to Cart buttons there is a very long list of pack photo tiles. Each one takes a separate Tab press, and after about 28 of them I still had not reached the Add to Cart button, so a keyboard user cannot add the item.
The pack tiles are plain divs that only announce a technical code like A26-[name]_AN-22 front photo. They have no button or radio role, no selected state, and Enter on one gave no visible feedback.
The filter choices All, Warm, Cool, Surprise Me and Pick Your Pack are focusable divs without button semantics, so it is unclear they can be pressed or which one is chosen.
No shortcut past the tile list exists: the skip link only jumps to the top of the main area, and the arrow keys did nothing to move through or out of the tiles.

The first Tab stops on an accessibility-guide link and then the Skip to Content link. Pressing Enter on the skip link only moved focus to the main region without showing any change on screen, which is confusing.
